title: Pricewatch
subtitle: A local product watchlist for tracking GBP prices and price history.
story: Pricewatch brings product links into a local watchlist with saved images, GBP price history and the lowest observed price. Browser-assisted checks capture prices from retailer pages and report failures while preserving the last verified observation. Built with React, TypeScript, a Node.js API and SQLite, it keeps the watchlist on your computer.
